contract: design.MD: owner-approved page titles 16px/24px/600 and compact record values 14px/20px/600, consistently across laptop, desktop, mobile and Arabic RTL.

contractDetails.surface: MAQDAR shared authenticated page headers and compact planning records
contractDetails.job: Read planning records and navigate between operational pages with the owner-approved compact typography.
contractDetails.reference: design.MD; owner selection on 2026-10-19; reported disposition-batch title and location code
constraints: Page titles are 16px/24px/600 and compact record values are 14px/20px/600 at every viewport.
Body, subtitle, sidebar and action text remain 14px/20px; captions remain 12px/16px.
Preserve locale font families, natural wrapping, local table scrolling, mobile 16px inputs and 44px action targets.
Preserve documented Dashboard numeric KPI, login display and help-panel exceptions.
Preserve calculations, currency precision, authorization, HTTP 404 behavior and existing loading boundaries.

accessibility.evidence: Browser workflows verify named controls, keyboard action order, visible focus and 44px mobile targets in LTR/RTL. Sixteen isolated UI fixtures pass, including help-dialog focus trapping, Escape and focus restoration. Loading and login checks exercise reduced motion. Representative captures were inspected for text legibility and wrapping; this is not a full accessibility certification.

responsive.evidence: Inspected laptop, desktop and mobile captures in English and Arabic RTL. Browser matrices assert the approved computed type roles, locale font families and no page overflow; horizontal tables remain locally scrollable. The disposition batch checks all four record values at 375, 768, 1024, 1366, 1440 and 1920px. These are Chromium CSS viewports, not physical-device or Safari checks.

loading.evidence: The Imports streaming and shared-header tests pass with illustrated loading banners, stable existing boundaries and reduced motion; loading title placeholders now use the shared 24px title line-height variable.

empty.evidence: The excess-stock list capture and workflow retain the compact heading, filter controls, empty-result explanation and new-assessment action.

error.evidence: Header-consistency exercises the Forecasts error/recovery state with the shared banner and compact title, including Arabic RTL.

partial.evidence: Dashboard fixtures retain truthful unavailable valuation, missing stock observations and currency-specific data without introducing sample production metrics.

success.evidence: Disposition batches are selected, previewed and saved through the real local application. The saved detail title and location, intent, date and exact currency value use the approved compact roles; original CSV/JSON downloads are checked unchanged.

permission.evidence: Disposition batch, header and Imports workflows retain tenant/location restrictions, hidden-record HTTP 404 assertions and viewer boundaries. No permission or data-access code changes.

renderedEvidence.observation: English laptop list: compact title, unchanged sidebar/body scale and naturally wrapping header actions.
Actual local production captures show the disposition-batch page title reduced from 20px to 16px and record values from 16px to 14px.
Arabic RTL before/after uses the same compact roles and the configured Arabic font family without clipping the header or record values.
Saved disposition batch: all four summary values use 14px/20px/600; header and download controls retain readable text and keyboard focus.
Arabic RTL mobile detail: compact title, naturally stacked record values, 44px actions and local table scrolling.
Arabic RTL mobile create screen preserves the compact title and 44px actions with no page overflow. Existing untranslated planning copy uses the documented English fallback.
